'''Skeleton Mages''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] or after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. They can also be found in the [[Quarry Mine]] at any time. 50 Skeletons (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
Skeleton Mages have two distinct spells that fire from a distance, a white spell that follows a straight line and deals damage to the player, and a blue spell that "trembles", similar to the [[Shadow Shaman]] long-distance spell, and causes the {{Name|Frozen|link=Buffs#Frozen{{!}}Frozen|class=inline}} debuff, paralyzing the player for 2 seconds. In addition to casting spells, the Skeleton Mage approaches the player to deal collision damage.

==Strategy==
The Skeleton Mage raises its hands when it is about to cast a spell; at this point dodge, then approach and attack quickly and back away when it prepares to fire again. If caught by its freezing spell, just attack to try to keep enemies away.
